subject: Pilot continuity: short runway while purchasing completes
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthedge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthedge.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short runway while procurement completes

Camila —

Quick note from procurement: our internal PO and vendor onboarding are likely to clear only by Jan 20 (legal routing + finance approvals). We have an active pilot and the engineering team is mid-integration — losing access would set the project back.

Can Redwood provision a short runway (tokens or temporary credits) to keep our proof-of-concept live until the PO is issued? Ideally 10k tokens or two weeks of sandbox access would be perfect. Procurement also asked for a SOC2 summary and a purchase timeline; attaching a one-page timeline now.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to provide a PO number as soon as it’s available.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Product Operations Lead
HealtheEdge

Attachments: procurement-timeline.pdf (1 page)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthedge.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthedge.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short runway while procurement completes

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the timeline. We can absolutely support keeping the pilot live while your PO clears; I just need quick internal approvals for a short runway.

Two options we can action immediately:
- Provision a 72-hour emergency token grant (immediate) + follow with a 10-day access top-up when PO is still pending, or
- Grant a straight 14-day sandbox credit (~$1,500 equivalent).

Which would help your engineers the most? I’m looping in Priyom from Sales Ops to confirm the right approval path and Vanessa from Finance for provisioning. If you can share an expected PO date and approver, that’ll speed it along.

I’ve attached a short usage summary so you can confirm numbers with your team.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128

Attachments: pilot-usage-summary.csv
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: short runway while procurement completes

PRIYOM / VANESSA — forwarding HealtheEdge ask. Summary: customer requests either a 72-hour immediate credit + 10-day top-up if PO delayed, or a 14-day credit (~$1.5k). Deal is active, Pilot usage shows steady daily token burn (attached). They expect PO to clear around Jan 20 but legal routing could slip. Deal: DEAL-HE-2026-01.

What I need from you:
- Priyom: confirm if Sales Ops will accept the 72hr + 10-day approach vs a single 14-day credit for deal tracking.
- Vanessa: if finance can provision an emergency token grant and record as a bridging credit against the PO when it arrives. If possible, please include the accounting memo (ticket FIN-8891) in the provisioning note.

We have SOC2 & vendor onboarding questions incoming; attaching a SOC2 overview to speed procurement.

Thanks — cc’ing the customer on the loop after internal sign-off.

— Camila

Attachments: SOC2-overview.pdf, pilot-usage-summary.csv
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short runway while procurement completes

Camila / Priyom —

Approved. Finance will provision a 72-hour emergency token grant immediately (token batch: 10,000) and schedule a 10-day top-up (equivalent to $1,200) to be applied if PO has not been received by Jan 15. Please note the internal rules: bridging credits must be reconciled to the inbound PO and cannot be converted to refunds. I’ve logged the request under ticket FIN-8891 and created a provisioning task for the platform team.

Steps I’ve taken:
- Created FIN ticket FIN-8891
- Approved emergency token grant: 10,000 tokens (effective immediately)
- Set conditional 10-day sandbox credit (apply if PO not in system by 2026-01-15)
- Added note to the deal in CRM: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-HE-2026-01

Priyom — please push the DocuSign/PO reminder to the customer contact and capture the expected PO approver. Camila, you’re good to confirm the emergency grant to the customer.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthedge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthedge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity: short runway while purchasing completes

Camila — you are a lifesaver, thank you. We received the emergency grant and the engineers are back up. Procurement is now pushing the PO through and we expect signatures by Jan 19. I’ve shared the SOC2 overview with our legal team and will upload the PO number to the DocuSign link once it’s routed.

Will confirm when the PO posts — appreciate the fast support.

Best,
Elena
